tools.name: search
tools.description: Search trending fashion, accessories and interior pieces. Free-text query, hard filters (category, tier, price, colors, size, brand, availability, ship_to) and an optional taste profile (style tags, liked and avoided colors, price comfort). Returns 5 to 20 ranked items with price, availability, imag

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Full record for one item id from a previous result: sizes, materials, colors, shipping regions, seller, and (with a key) silhouette, occasion, season and trend data.

tools.name: trending
tools.description: What is hot or rising right now, ranked by trend score, optionally within a category or tier. Hot means confirmed by demand; rising means early momentum.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Alternatives to one item: close in style, optionally filtered (for example max_price for a cheaper option, or availability).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
